primitives.title: Stud Tube Open
primitives.derivation: inward 4-4cyli radius 6 and outward 4-4cyli radius 8 from y=-4 to y=0, with the 4-4ring3 rim at y=-4 (the open end) and parts scaling it along Y; the four stud-grid diagonal neighbours sit 10*sqrt(2) from the axis, so a radius-6 receptor there clears the radius-8 wall by 10*sqrt(2)-14 and runs from the rim plane to the far end; emitted only where the free-space test finds the receptor open

primitives.title: Stud Tube Open without Base Edges
primitives.derivation: inward 4-4cyli radius 6 and outward 4-4cyli radius 8 from y=-4 to y=0, with the 4-4ring3 rim at y=-4 (the open end) and parts scaling it along Y; the four stud-grid diagonal neighbours sit 10*sqrt(2) from the axis, so a radius-6 receptor there clears the radius-8 wall by 10*sqrt(2)-14 and runs from the rim plane to the far end; emitted only where the free-space test finds the receptor open

primitives.title: Stud

primitives.title: Stud Open

primitives.title: Stud Open without Base Edges

primitives.title: Stud Open with Small Holes

primitives.title: Stud Truncated Laterally Curved 40D for Round  2 x  2 Parts
primitives.derivation: outward 3-4cyli radius 6 from y=0 to y=-4, closed by 3-4disc radius 6 at y=-4; the remaining quadrant is a curved truncation of quads through (5.6145, 1.9397), (4.142, 4.142) and (1.9397, 5.6145), capped by triangles at y=-4; drawn in colour 16 only

primitives.title: Stud Truncated Laterally Straight 40D for Round  2 x  2 Parts
primitives.derivation: outward 3-4cylc radius 6 from y=0 to y=-4; the remaining quadrant is a straight truncation of quads from (6, 0) through (5.6145, 1.9388) and (1.9388, 5.6145) to (0, 6), capped by a triangle and a quad at y=-4; drawn in colour 16 only
